# TEST DATA ONLY - not an official document

## Batteries

Used household batteries must not be placed in the wet or dry waste bins. Keep used batteries in a closed box away from heat and hand them over at a battery collection point.

## Medicines

Expired medicines should be kept in their original strips and handed over separately. Do not flush medicines down the toilet and do not burn them.

## Kitchen waste

Vegetable peels, leftover food and tea leaves are wet waste. They can be composted at home or given to the wet waste collection.
